summary:
Public Law 119-13 is a joint resolution of congressional disapproval enacted pursuant to the Congressional Review Act, chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code. Its sole operative provision disapproves the rule submitted by the National Park Service, Department of the Interior, entitled “Glen Canyon National Recreation Area: Motor Vehicles,” published at 90 Fed. Reg. 2621.

By the resolution’s terms, the disapproved rule “shall have no force or effect.” The enactment does not amend any provision of the United States Code, create new regulatory authority, impose substitute standards for motor vehicle use in the Glen Canyon National Recreation Area, or direct the National Park Service to undertake further rulemaking. It contains no express exceptions, savings clause, transition rule, implementation deadline, authorization of appropriations, or appropriation. The operative legal consequence is the nullification of the specified submitted rule under the Congressional Review Act mechanism for congressional disapproval.

The joint resolution was approved May 23, 2025.
